generation.scope: For an irreducible symmetric first net with dependent self-brackets, every smooth prescribed cubic through its harmonic base has a complete rational conic of complementary symmetric planes. Its open nonzero fibers omit two distinct points or a single double boundary, depending on whether the residual point is detached from or attached to the apolar commuting triple. Together with the elliptic quintic for independent self-brackets, this handles the complementary-plane step for every irreducible first net over smooth cubics, including the fixed-metric exceptions.

open_mathematics: Recover all skew-commutator triples with a smooth prescribed determinant by linear symmetrizers and determinantal representations of the cubic. Determine how to match their ordered target matrices back to the symmetric planes and finally test the all-degree conditions on the resulting fibers.
